name: Nǁng

ancestors.notes: Descent per Glottolog classification of Nǁng (nngg1234).

notes: Tuu (!Ui branch) click language of South Africa (Nǁng/Nǀuu), critically endangered. This is an honest PARTIAL skeleton: there is no single standardized community orthography, and the descriptive literature presents the inventory in phonetic transcription rather than a settled spelling. The five click places and the g-/n-/h-/x-/glottal accompaniment digraphs above follow general Khoisanist transcription convention and are plausible but not confirmed as official. Tone, the strident/pharyngealized vowel phonation, and many finer click airstream and phonation contrasts are not represented, so a substantial PER floor is expected. Nǁng/Nǀuu tone is not consistently recoverable from the partial community orthography and is left unencoded; stress is not a separate contrastive category (documented exemption). Tier stays at skeleton (not research) despite the cited Namaseb 2022 dictionary/sketch: the grapheme table itself remains an unconfirmed plausible transcription convention, not the settled community spelling the research tier presumes.
